cohort: Mother-preterm infant dyads in a KMC unit in Malawi
finding: Mother-infant dyads receiving both H-HOPE and KMC had higher responsivity at 6-weeks corrected age than those receiving KMC only.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was associated with higher mother-infant responsivity compared to Caesarean delivery.
gest_age: Preterm, at least 32 weeks postmenstrual age
